fusions.name: Deadwood Club
fusions.desc: Swings a torn-off limb as a club that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Pelted from Above
fusions.desc: Throws 3 hard green fruits pulled from your crown in a spread out to 7 tiles; each one deals 6 damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Hand over Hand
fusions.desc: Swings you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Gnarled Grip
fusions.desc: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your armour rises by 5%, from silver your stamina recovers 12% faster, and from gold you attack 5% faster.
